title: Bifrost Bench suite
description: benchmarks/<id>/suite.yaml: one versioned benchmark pack. Mirrors schemas.Suite.

id.description: Pack id; equals the folder name under benchmarks/.

grader.description: Grader part name. hidden_tests: pytest JUnit at /grader/out/junit.xml, the original Python grader. verifier_command: any language, reporting as junit, reward or exit_code (docs/verifiers.md). answer_match and judge: answer tasks (docs/scenarios-design.md). visual: output.visual, images the bench captures (X1, docs/visual-grading.md). checks: each task's declarative verifier/checks.yaml (tool calls, arguments, call order, final state, reply rubric; docs/declarative-checks.md); a task without one is graded by the verifier command.

restore.description: Paths reset to the pristine repo before grading.

result.description: How the command reports (verifier_command only). junit: JUnit XML at result_path. reward: a number, or {"reward": n, "dimensions": {...}}, at result_path. exit_code: exit 0 passes.

result_path.description: Result file inside the verifier container, directly in /grader/out, which the grader creates empty for each grade. Default /grader/out/junit.xml or /grader/out/reward.json.

pass_threshold.description: Lowest reward that passes (result reward only).

track.description: Leaderboard track; empty means coding. support: W3 customer support. research: W4 research with Tavily. voice: X8 voice agents.

simulator.description: W3 customer support: the user simulator, pinned like a judge (docs/customer-support.md).

clock.description: Z17 run clock of every task without its own: the time services and the agent see (BENCH_NOW, BENCH_CLOCK_RATE, FAKETIME), hashed into the lock (schemas/clock.go).

rate.description: Clock seconds per real second; 0 means 1.

tiers.description: W7 suite tiers: tier name to the scalar all or a list of task ids, e.g. pr, nightly, headroom (docs/suite-tiers.md).

grading.description: verified (default) or judged; a judged suite needs judge.

services.description: Started beside the agent in every run; paths relative to the suite root.

external.description: Real HTTP APIs every task's agent may call through the tool proxy (docs/external-apis.md); cassette paths relative to the suite root.

canary.description: Contamination canary GUID, set by `suite canary` (docs/held-out-and-canaries.md).

requires.description: Agent capabilities the benchmark needs. Empty derives them from track and environment.

realism.description: Eval integrity area (S2): neutral gives the agent neutral variable names and hostnames, stamps no canary and names observer processes innocuously (docs/eval-awareness.md). Default standard; an experiment's realism overrides it.

codescan.description: X4: optional external code scanners (docs/code-scan.md), run after the agent in the clean room on the pristine repository plus the diff, with no network; their SARIF results count only on lines the agent added. Off unless declared.

image.description: base (the suite's locked base image) or an image pinned by digest.

auditor.description: W8 judge calibration: an optional second judge from another provider. Its disagreement marks a run contested for human review; it never changes a grade (docs/judge-calibration.md).

simulator.description: W3 customer support: user simulator settings (schemas.SimulatorSpec).
